observation_scope_interpretation.n_ge1: species with any historical photo opportunity; image colour not necessarily classifiable
observation_scope_interpretation.n_ge5: screened visible colour occurrence only; failure to see rare morph not natural monomorphism
observation_scope_interpretation.n_ge20: comparative visible-colour diversity has broad but imperfect photographic support
observation_scope_interpretation.n_ge40: candidate species for minimum measured within-species ITV
observation_scope_interpretation.n_ge100: candidate species for higher-depth geographic colour association, not necessarily enough local photo pairs

claim_limits: metadata-only observer-capped photo availability is not actual measured flower-colour photos
zero-photo species remain in the denominator as NOT OBSERVED, not white/monomorphic
single-photo species yield no within-species colour variation estimates
two or five photo labels cannot reliably prove the absence of rare flower colour variants
presence in >1 equal-area cell is not proof of photographed reproductive populations or ecological adaptation
the 42111 species are an outcome-blind iNaturalist discovered opportunity frame, not all world angiosperms
primary benefit-cost/selection mechanisms, genotypes and white anthocyanin absence are not measured
